correctness.rationale: The bijection between even covered masks and perfect matchings on the covered set gives double-factorial multiplicities. Gaussian even moments yield the multiplier exactly. The centered chi-square mgf exp(sum_{r>=2} 2^{r-1}t^r/r) proves positive moments at all orders >=2. The exact nonnegative expansion isolates the only zeros (n,k)=(2,1),(3,1),(3,2) and proves sign for all other points. Alternating binomial sums prove inertia. Exact checker independently verifies 11014 assertions through n=12 by exhaustive matching recursion/Walsh and through n=50 by independent binomial and moment methods.

The result exactly characterizes invertibility of its counting convolution for every size, with an unexpected pair of finite singular exceptions and full positive/negative spectral inertia at every later size; this information is not implied by total counts or univariate matching-polynomial root location.
